name: prabha
displayName: PRABHA — Turbo C graphics.h in VS Code
description: Run classic Turbo C/C++ graphics.h and conio.h programs inside VS Code — complete BGI runtime, 640x480 16-colour VGA panel, real getch/kbhit keyboard, no DOSBox. Now with an in-built compiler: no gcc? PRABHA installs one in one click.

commands.title: PRABHA: Which compiler am I using?

prabha.cCompiler.description: C compiler for .c files and the PRABHA runtime. Leave as 'gcc' to auto-detect (PATH, CodeBlocks/MSYS2/TDM/WinGet folders, or PRABHA's own GCC).

prabha.cppCompiler.description: C++ compiler for .cpp files. Leave as 'g++' to auto-detect.

prabha.extraFlags.description: Extra flags appended to the compile command.

prabha.scale.description: Screen scale of the 640x480 panel (1 = actual size).

prabha.keepPanelOpenOnExit.description: Keep the last frame on screen after the program exits.

prabha.turboCppCompatibility.markdownDescription: Run classic **Turbo C++ / Borland C++** programs unchanged on your modern compiler. When on, `#include <iostream.h>`, unqualified `cout`/`cin`, and `void main()` all work without editing your source. Turn off if you only write standard modern C++ and want strict compilation.

prabha.toolchainUrl.description: Windows only: download URL of a WinLibs GCC .zip to use instead of the pinned version (advanced; no checksum check for custom URLs).
